Game Overview

In Poppy it Playtime, the core idea is straightforward: brace yourself for a heart-pounding race against time in Poppy it Playtime. Navigate an eerie factory, quickly matching and eliminating pop it toys while evading the relentless Poppy. Challenge your reflexes and strategy as the tension mounts with every level. Will you escape before time is up?
